sections.heading: Likely Fixable In Current xterm Path
body: - Realtime PTY output hot path: each chunk flows through Tauri event delivery, ACK accounting, snapshot/preview broadcast, raw output buffering, and regex detection.
- Chat readiness: `codex app-server --stdio` and `thread/list` are fast, while `thread/start` takes about 7.6-12s and currently blocks Chat UI ready.
- Snapshot restore: `Shell.jsx` writes `history + data` into xterm in one `term.write()` call; still needs a dedicated restore trace.
- Scrollback: xterm is configured at `scrollback: 3000`; large output reaches that cap and still needs 1000/1500/3000 A/B.

sections.heading: Likely WebView / xterm Ceiling
body: - None confirmed in this run. ThreadTerm WebView2 is hardware accelerated; direct xterm write is far faster than the real PTY path, so the current bottleneck is not the renderer/GPU.

sections.heading: Unknown / Needs Repeat
body: - Pure historical scroll FPS and long tasks.
- Restart/session restore Performance trace.
- Windows Terminal side-by-side control for the same large-output scenario.
- Scrollback A/B at 1000 / 1500 / 3000.
- Full 10 MB / 100 MB baseline, high-refresh TUI, selection, Unicode, IME, font clarity, and multi-terminal stress scenarios.

sections.heading: Decision
body: Choose one:
- stop native renderer work and optimize xterm only
- continue to W1 native host spike
- repeat W0 after instrumentation fixes
Decision: stop native renderer work and optimize xterm/output hot paths first; repeat W0 measurements after the PTY event / ACK / snapshot-preview fixes before considering W1.

sections.heading: Follow-Up Tasks
body: - Move snapshot/preview work out of the per-chunk realtime output hot path, or batch/throttle it behind the visible terminal write.
- Split Chat UI readiness from `thread/start` so the app-server connection is not presented as blocked for 7-12s.
- Run the missing pure scroll, restore, scrollback A/B, and Windows Terminal control measurements before any TerminalControl / native host spike.
